name: Sea wall
definition: A hard engineered structure along a shoreline that resists wave action, surge and erosion.
cdp_labels: Sea walls and coastal protection structures

name: Levee
definition: An earthen or concrete barrier along a river or coast that keeps floodwater out of the protected area.
cdp_labels: Flood defence, such as flood levees and culverts

name: Storm surge barrier
definition: A movable or fixed barrier across an estuary or channel that closes against storm surge.

name: Culvert and bridge opening upgrade
definition: Enlarging or replacing culverts and bridge openings so that watercourses pass design floods.

name: Flood detention basin
definition: An engineered basin that temporarily stores floodwater and releases it slowly.

name: Stormwater drainage upgrade
definition: Expanding or rebuilding piped and channel drainage so it carries larger storm flows.

name: Combined sewer overflow control
definition: Measures that keep combined sewers from discharging untreated flow during storms.

name: Flood pump station
definition: A pumping installation that moves stormwater or floodwater out of low-lying areas.

name: Rainwater harvesting
definition: Collecting and storing rainfall from roofs or surfaces for later use.

name: Water recycling and reuse
definition: Treating wastewater or greywater for reuse in place of fresh supply.

name: Desalination
definition: Producing fresh water from seawater or brackish water.

name: Water supply diversification
definition: Adding supply sources or interconnections so that a city is not dependent on one source.

name: Managed aquifer recharge
definition: Deliberately replenishing aquifers with surface or recycled water.

name: Water efficiency retrofit
definition: Replacing fixtures, appliances and processes to cut water use.

name: Leak detection and loss reduction
definition: Finding and fixing losses in the distribution network.

name: Smart water metering
definition: Metering that reports consumption continuously to utility and customer.

name: Water use restrictions
definition: Rules that limit water use during drought or shortage.

name: Water pricing and tariffs
definition: Price structures that reward lower or off-peak water use.

name: Flood and water level monitoring
definition: Sensors and gauges that report water levels in rivers, sewers and the sea in real time.

name: Hydrological and flood modelling
definition: Models that estimate where and how deep water goes under storms, tides and sea-level rise.

name: Integrated water resource management
definition: Managing supply, stormwater, wastewater and ecosystems together in one planning frame.

name: Water and wastewater treatment upgrade
definition: Expanding, hardening or relocating treatment works.
cdp_labels: Ensure access to resilient secure, sustainable and safely managed sanitation services

name: Water quality monitoring
definition: Monitoring contaminants in supply, rivers or coastal water.

name: Green infrastructure
definition: Vegetated and soil-based systems that manage stormwater and provide ecosystem services, used as the umbrella class when the text names no specific measure.

name: Rain garden
definition: A planted depression that captures and infiltrates runoff from nearby surfaces.

name: Bioswale
definition: A vegetated channel that slows, filters and infiltrates runoff.

name: Constructed wetland
definition: An engineered wetland built to store and treat stormwater or wastewater.

name: Wetland and floodplain restoration
definition: Restoring wetlands, floodplains or buried watercourses to store and slow floodwater.
cdp_labels: Ecological restoration (including wetland and floodplain conservation and restoration)

name: Living shoreline
definition: A shoreline stabilised with vegetation, oyster reef or sand instead of hard structure.

name: Beach and dune nourishment
definition: Adding sand to beaches or dunes to maintain a buffer against erosion and surge.

name: Mangrove conservation and restoration
definition: Protecting or replanting mangrove forest as coastal defence and habitat.

name: Reef restoration
definition: Restoring or building reefs that attenuate waves.

name: Urban tree planting
definition: Planting and maintaining trees in streets, parks and private land for shade, cooling and stormwater benefit.

name: Urban greening
definition: Adding vegetated public space in the urban fabric, used when the text names no specific measure.

name: Green corridor
definition: A connected strip of vegetated land that links habitats or open spaces.

name: Protected natural area
definition: Land designated and managed for conservation.
cdp_labels: Preservation of local and regional agricultural space

name: Biodiversity and ecosystem monitoring
definition: Systematic observation of species and habitats.

name: Ecosystem-based adaptation
definition: Using ecosystems and their services to reduce climate risk, as an umbrella class when no specific measure is named.
cdp_labels: Ex situ conservation and seed banks

name: Prescribed burning and fuel reduction
definition: Deliberate burning or clearing of vegetation to reduce wildfire fuel.

name: Invasive species and vector control
definition: Managing invasive species, pests and disease vectors whose range shifts with climate.

name: Fisheries management
definition: Rules and institutions that keep fisheries within sustainable limits.

name: Slope and erosion control
definition: Vegetation or structures that hold soil on slopes and riverbanks.

name: Green roof
definition: A roof covered with growing medium and vegetation.

name: Cool roof
definition: A roof surface with high solar reflectance that lowers building and ambient temperature.

name: Building cooling retrofit
definition: Installing or upgrading mechanical cooling in existing buildings.

name: Passive cooling and ventilation
definition: Building design that keeps interiors cool without mechanical cooling.

name: Building insulation and envelope upgrade
definition: Improving the thermal envelope of buildings.

name: Building floodproofing
definition: Modifying a building so that flooding does less damage.
cdp_labels: Resilience and resistance measures for buildings

name: Resilient building code
definition: Code and standard provisions that require buildings to withstand climate hazards.

name: Resilient and modular housing
definition: Housing built or retrofitted to resist local hazards.

name: Shade structures
definition: Built shade and misting in public space.

name: Wildfire home hardening
definition: Building and landscape measures that reduce ignition of structures by wildfire.

name: Post-disaster repair and rebuilding
definition: Repairing and rebuilding damaged buildings to a higher standard.

name: Affordable and climate-safe housing
definition: Housing programmes that keep vulnerable residents in safe, affordable homes; recorded as a Solution only when framed as adaptation.

name: Permeable pavement
definition: Paving that lets water infiltrate rather than run off.

name: Critical infrastructure hardening
definition: Strengthening or protecting infrastructure assets against hazards, used when the asset class is not specific.
cdp_labels: Hazard resistant infrastructure design and construction

name: Infrastructure relocation
aliases: relocating infrastructure out of hazard zones
definition: Moving an asset out of a hazard zone.

name: Infrastructure condition monitoring
definition: Instrumenting assets to detect deterioration and hazard impact.

name: Digital twin and smart city platform
definition: A data platform that models the city for planning and operations.

name: Resilient waste management
definition: Waste systems that keep operating through hazards and reduce exposure.
cdp_labels: Ensure all waste generated is collected ensure residual waste disposed of adequately in an engineered sanitary landfill
Municipal services to reduce food waste (including composting)

name: Microgrid
definition: A local grid that can operate independently of the main grid.

name: Battery storage and backup power
definition: Stored or standby power that keeps services running in outages.

name: Solar photovoltaics
definition: Solar electricity generation, recorded as a Solution when framed as resilience.

name: Grid hardening
definition: Strengthening generation and distribution assets against hazards.
cdp_labels: Increase resilience of and/or diversify power/energy supply

name: Transmission line undergrounding
definition: Moving overhead lines underground.

name: Utility vegetation management
definition: Managing vegetation near power lines to prevent outages and ignition.

name: Renewable energy
definition: Renewable generation other than solar PV, recorded when framed as resilience.

name: Energy efficiency
definition: Reducing energy demand in buildings and systems.

name: Cool pavement
definition: Road surfaces that reflect more sunlight.

name: Road and bridge hardening
definition: Strengthening, raising or protecting roads, bridges and tunnels.

name: Resilient transit
definition: Protecting transit systems and keeping them running through hazards.

name: Fleet electrification
definition: Electrifying vehicles and fleets, recorded when framed as resilience.

name: Evacuation routes and logistics
definition: Designated routes and logistics for moving people and goods in an emergency.

name: Transit-oriented development
definition: Dense, mixed-use development around transit, recorded when framed as resilience.

name: Cooling centre
definition: A public facility opened during heat for people to cool down.

name: Resilience hub
definition: A trusted community facility equipped to support residents before, during and after a hazard event.

name: Emergency shelter
definition: A facility that houses people displaced by a hazard event.

name: Heat health programme
definition: Coordinated public-health response to extreme heat, including outreach and warnings.

name: Air quality programme
definition: Measures that reduce or monitor air pollution worsened by heat and wildfire.
cdp_labels: Measuring days with extreme air pollution due to climate events
Undertaken source-related studies to understand sources of air pollution

name: Disease surveillance and prevention
definition: Monitoring and preventing climate-sensitive disease.
cdp_labels: Public health policies to improve nutrition (including improved access to healthy foods)

name: Heat stress monitoring
definition: Measuring heat exposure of people and places.

name: Urban agriculture
definition: Growing food within the city.
cdp_labels: Financial support to expand local food production (including urban agriculture programs, community gardens, etc.)
Land zoning laws to increase local food access (including grocery stores, farmers markets, community gardens, etc.)

name: Climate-resilient cropping
definition: Changing crops, varieties or practices to suit a changed climate.
cdp_labels: Changing cropping practices, patterns, and planting dates (including crop-switching)

name: Efficient irrigation
definition: Irrigation that delivers water with less loss.

name: Food storage and cold chain
definition: Facilities that keep food safe and available through disruption.
cdp_labels: Cold food storage, preservation and/or distribution facilities

name: Food security programme
definition: Programmes and policies that keep food affordable and available, recorded when framed as adaptation.
cdp_labels: Food donation and redistribution of food surplus
Community engagement/awareness campaigns on the climate and health benefits of sustainable healthy diets
Engagement with retailers (including restaurants) to expand and encourage sustainable, healthy food choices
Financial support to improve market access for local food producers
Municipal/jurisdictional food procurement policies that align with guidelines for sustainable, healthy diets (including school procurement, etc.)
Municipal/jurisdictional food procurement policies that support sustainable food production practices (including school procurement, etc.)
Public policies to encourage citizen dietary shift to sustainable, healthy diets (including incentivizing purchase of low-carbon foods, plant-based or alternative proteins)

name: Drought monitoring
definition: Monitoring that detects drought onset and severity.

name: Climate risk insurance
definition: Insurance products that transfer climate risk, including requirements to carry them.

name: Resilience incentives and subsidies
definition: Payments, rebates or tax measures that reward adaptation by households and firms.

name: Resilience lending
definition: Loan programmes that fund adaptation by households, firms or communities.

name: Disaster contingency fund
definition: A reserve set aside to pay for response and recovery.

name: Social protection and cash transfers
definition: Transfers and safety nets that cushion households against climate shocks.
cdp_labels: Social safety nets and social protection

name: Economic and livelihood diversification
definition: Reducing dependence on climate-exposed livelihoods and sectors.

name: Climate risk and vulnerability assessment
definition: A structured assessment of hazards, exposure and vulnerability.

name: Managed retreat
definition: Moving people and assets out of hazard zones through buyouts or relocation.

name: Hazard-based zoning and land-use regulation
definition: Land-use rules that limit development in hazard-prone areas.
cdp_labels: Land zoning laws (including restrict development in at risk areas)

name: Adaptation and resilience planning
definition: A planning process or instrument for adaptation, recorded as a Solution only when a plan prescribes planning as a measure.
cdp_labels: Development of targeted plan/program to address hazard(s) selected

name: Disaster preparedness planning
definition: Institutional preparation for hazard events.
cdp_labels: Law to support disaster risk reduction

name: Urban heat mapping
definition: Mapping surface and air temperature across the city.

name: Hazard mapping
definition: Mapping hazard extent and probability other than flood and heat.

name: Climate and environmental monitoring
definition: Observation networks and remote sensing for climate and hazard conditions.

name: Climate projections and downscaling
definition: Producing local climate projections for planning.

name: Wildfire detection and suppression
definition: Systems that detect and suppress wildfire.

name: Early warning system
definition: A system that detects a hazard and warns people in time to act.

name: Community engagement and education
definition: Informing and involving residents in adaptation.

name: Community-based adaptation
definition: Adaptation designed and delivered by communities.

name: Preparedness training and drills
definition: Training residents and responders for hazard events.

name: Telecommunications hardening
definition: Keeping communications working through hazard events.

name: Emergency response capacity
definition: Equipment, staffing and facilities for emergency response.

name: Adaptation governance body
definition: A standing body or role that coordinates adaptation across government.

name: Climate mainstreaming in policy
definition: Requiring climate risk to be considered in routine decisions.

name: Informal settlement upgrading
definition: Improving services, housing and drainage in informal settlements.
